cv.name: Priya Natarajan
cv.headline: Compliance Analyst | BSA/AML, KYC & Regulatory Reporting
cv.summary: Compliance analyst with three and a half years in community banking and broker-dealer compliance. Works across transaction monitoring, customer due diligence and FINRA/SEC exam preparation, and is comfortable turning messy alert data into clear findings for the BSA Officer.

experience.title: Compliance Analyst
bullets: Review and disposition transaction monitoring alerts in Actimize; escalate unusual activity and draft SAR narratives
Perform enhanced due diligence on high-risk customers, including MSBs and cash-intensive businesses
Rebuilt the OFAC false-positive tuning log, cutting weekly manual reviews by roughly 30%
Coordinated document requests for the 2024 FDIC BSA examination with no findings for the compliance team

experience.title: Compliance Associate
bullets: Monitored employee trading and outside business activity disclosures against FINRA Rule 3210 and 3270
Maintained the firm's marketing review log and archived approved communications

skills: FINRA and SEC rules, Reg S-P
Excel (pivot tables, Power Query), basic SQL
